title: पञ्चसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: While Arjuna keeps the enemy off with arrows and the pool is made, Krishna bathes and waters the horses and sets them to the chariot again. The Kauravas are shaken, and Sanjaya laments the king's fault.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನ ಬಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ಶತ್ರುಗಳನ್ನು ತಡೆದು ಸರೋವರ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾದಾಗ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಕುದುರೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ನಾನ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ ನೀರು ಕುಡಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ರಥಕ್ಕೆ ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕೌರವರು ನಡುಗುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಸಂಜಯ ರಾಜನ ತಪ್ಪನ್ನು ಹಳಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन के बाणों से शत्रुओं को रोके रहने और सरोवर बन जाने पर कृष्ण घोड़ों को नहलाकर पानी पिलाते हैं और फिर रथ में जोतते हैं। कौरव काँप उठते हैं, और संजय राजा के दोष का शोक करते हैं।
summary.te: అర్జునుడు బాణాలతో శత్రువులను ఆపుతుండగా సరస్సు సిద్ధమయ్యాక కృష్ణుడు గుర్రాలను స్నానం చేయించి నీరు తాగించి రథానికి మళ్లీ కడతాడు. కౌరవులు వణుకుతారు; సంజయుడు రాజు దోషాన్ని తప్పుపడతాడు.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனன் அம்புகளால் பகைவரைத் தடுக்க, குளம் உண்டானதும் கண்ணன் குதிரைகளைக் குளிப்பாட்டி நீர் புகட்டி மீண்டும் தேரில் பூட்டுகிறார். கௌரவர் நடுங்க, மன்னனின் குற்றத்தைச் சஞ்சயன் இடித்துரைக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: അർജുനൻ അമ്പുകൊണ്ട് ശത്രുക്കളെ അകറ്റിനിർത്തുമ്പോൾ, കൃഷ്ണൻ സ്നാനം ചെയ്ത് കുതിരകൾക്ക് വെള്ളം കൊടുത്ത് അവയെ വീണ്ടും തേരിൽ കെട്ടുന്നു. കൗരവർ ഇളകിപ്പോകുന്നു; രാജാവിന്റെ തെറ്റിനെക്കുറിച്ച് സഞ്ജയൻ വിലപിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.75; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
सलिले जनिते तस्मिन्कौन्तेयेन महात्मना ।
निवारिते द्विषत्सैन्ये कृते च शरवेश्मनि ॥

meaning.en: When the great-souled son of Kunti had made the water, held back the enemy army and built the house of arrows,

verses.text:
वासुदेवो रथात्तूर्णमवतीर्य महाद्युतिः ।
मोचयामास तुरगान्वितुन्नान्कङ्कपत्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: radiant Vasudeva quickly got down from the chariot and unyoked the horses, which were pricked by heron-feathered arrows.

verses.text:
अदृष्टपूर्वं तद्दृष्ट्वा सिंहनादो महानभूत् ।
सिद्धचारणसंघानां सैनिकानां च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing what had never been seen before, a great lion-roar went up from the hosts of siddhas and charanas and from the soldiers everywhere.

verses.text:
पदातिनं तु कौन्तेयं युध्यमानं नरर्षभाः ।
नाशक्नुवन्वारयितुं तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: The bulls among men could not hold back Kunti's son as he fought on foot; and that was a marvel.

verses.text:
आपतत्सु रथौघेषु प्रभूतगजवाजिषु ।
नासंभ्रमत्तदा पार्थस्तदस्य पुरुषानति ॥

meaning.en: Though masses of chariots rushed on, with many elephants and horses, Partha was not at all flustered, nor did he think them men.

verses.text:
व्यसृजन्त शरौघांस्ते पाण्डवं प्रति पार्थिवाः ।
न चाव्यथत धर्मात्मा वासविः परवीरहा ॥

meaning.en: The kings let fly floods of arrows at the Pandava, but that righteous son of Indra, slayer of enemy heroes, was not shaken.

verses.text:
स तानि शरजालानि गदाः प्रासांश्च वीर्यवान् ।
आगतानग्रसत्पार्थः सरितः सागरो यथा ॥

meaning.en: The valiant Partha swallowed those nets of arrows, maces and lances as they came, as the sea swallows rivers.

verses.text:
अस्त्रवेगेन महता पार्थो बाहुबलेन च ।
सर्वेषां पार्थिवेन्द्राणामग्रसत्ताञ्शरोत्तमान् ॥

meaning.en: With the great speed of his weapons and the strength of his arms, Partha swallowed the finest arrows of all the great kings.

verses.text:
तत्तु पार्थस्य विक्रान्तं वासुदेवस्य चोभयोः ।
अपूजयन्महाराज कौरवाः परमाद्भुतम् ॥

meaning.en: That prowess of Partha and of Vasudeva, both, the Kauravas honoured, great king, as supremely wondrous.

verses.text:
किमद्भुततरं लोके भविताप्यथ वाप्यभूत् ।
यदश्वान्पार्थगोविन्दौ मोचयामासतू रणे ॥

meaning.en: What could there be, now or ever, more wondrous in the world than that Partha and Govinda unyoked their horses in the battle?

verses.text:
भयं विपुलमस्मासु तावधत्तां नरोत्तमौ ।
तेजो विदधतुश्चोग्रं विस्रब्धौ रणमूर्धनि ॥

meaning.en: Those two best of men put great fear in us, and, fearless, displayed fierce splendour at the head of the battle.

verses.text:
अथोत्स्मयन्हृषीकेशः स्त्रीमध्य इव भारत ।
अर्जुनेन कृते संख्ये शरगर्भगृहे तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then Hrishikesha, as if smiling, O Bharata, as though in a house among women, in the house of arrows Arjuna had made in the battle,

verses.text:
उपावर्तयदव्यग्रस्तानश्वान्पुष्करेक्षणः ।
मिषतां सर्वसैन्यानां त्वदीयानां विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: calmly brought the horses round, the lotus-eyed one, before the eyes of all your armies, O lord of men.

verses.text:
तेषां श्रमं च ग्लानिं च वेपथुं वमथुं व्रणान् ।
सर्वं व्यपानुदत्कृष्णः कुशलो ह्यश्वकर्मणि ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, skilled in the care of horses, removed all their fatigue, exhaustion, trembling, retching and wounds.

verses.text:
शल्यानुद्धृत्य पाणिभ्यां परिमृज्य च तान्हयान् ।
उपावृत्य यथान्यायं पाययामास वारि सः ॥

meaning.en: Pulling out the arrow-heads with his hands and rubbing the horses down, he brought them round properly and gave them water to drink.

verses.text:
स ताँल्लब्धोदकान्स्नाताञ्जग्धान्नान्विगतक्लमान् ।
योजयामास संहृष्टः पुनरेव रथोत्तमे ॥

meaning.en: When they had had water, been bathed, had eaten and lost their weariness, he happily yoked them again to the excellent chariot.

verses.text:
स तं रथवरं शौरिः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ।
समास्थाय महातेजाः सार्जुनः प्रययौ द्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Shauri, best of all weapon-bearers, of great splendour, mounted that fine chariot and quickly went on with Arjuna.

verses.text:
रथं रथवरस्याजौ युक्तं लब्धोदकैर्हयैः ।
दृष्ट्वा कुरुबलश्रेष्ठाः पुनर्विमनसोऽभवन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the chariot of the best of charioteers yoked again with horses that had had water, the best of the Kuru force again lost heart.

verses.text:
विनिःश्वसन्तस्ते राजन्भग्नदंष्ट्रा इवोरगाः ।
धिगहो धिग्गतः पार्थः कृष्णश्चेत्यब्रुवन्पृथक् ॥

meaning.en: They sighed like snakes with broken fangs, O king, and each said: Shame! Alas, Partha and Krishna have gone!

verses.text:
सर्वक्षत्रस्य मिषतो रथेनैकेन दंशितौ ।
बालक्रीडनकेनेव कदर्थीकृत्य नो बलम् ॥

meaning.en: While all the kshatriyas looked on, those two, armoured in a single chariot, have made a mock of our army as if it were child's play.

verses.text:
क्रोशतां यतमानानामसंसक्तौ परंतपौ ।
दर्शयित्वात्मनो वीर्यं प्रयातौ सर्वराजसु ॥

meaning.en: As we shouted and strove, those two scorchers of foes, unchecked, showed their power and went on among all the kings.

verses.text:
तौ प्रयातौ पुनर्दृष्ट्वा तदान्ये सैनिकाब्रुवन् ।
त्वरध्वं कुरवः सर्वे वधे कृष्णकिरीटिनोः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the two going on again, other soldiers then said: Hurry, Kurus, all of you, to kill Krishna and Arjuna!

verses.text:
रथं युक्त्वा हि दाशार्हो मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम् ।
जयद्रथाय यात्येष कदर्थीकृत्य नो रणे ॥

meaning.en: The Dasharha has yoked his chariot before the eyes of all the bowmen, and is going to Jayadratha, making a mockery of us in the battle.

verses.text:
तत्र केचिन्मिथो राजन्समभाषन्त भूमिपाः ।
अदृष्टपूर्वं संग्रामे तद्दृष्ट्वा महदद्भुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Some of the kings there spoke among themselves, O king, seeing that great marvel never seen before in battle.

verses.text:
सर्वसैन्यानि राजा च धृतराष्ट्रोऽत्ययं गतः ।
दुर्योधनापराधेन क्षत्रं कृत्स्ना च मेदिनी ॥

meaning.en: They said: All the armies and King Dhritarashtra have come to ruin; through Duryodhana's fault the kshatriya order and the whole earth

verses.text:
विलयं समनुप्राप्ता तच्च राजा न बुध्यते ।
इत्येवं क्षत्रियास्तत्र ब्रुवन्त्यन्ये च भारत ॥

meaning.en: have come to destruction, and the king does not understand it. So the kshatriyas and others spoke there, O Bharata.

verses.text:
सिन्धुराजस्य यत्कृत्यं गतस्य यमसादनम् ।
तत्करोतु वृथादृष्टिर्धार्तराष्ट्रोऽनुपायवित् ॥

meaning.en: Let Dhritarashtra's son, with his vain sight, who knows no means, do what must be done for the king of the Sindhus, who has gone to Yama's house.

verses.text:
ततः शीघ्रतरं प्रायात्पाण्डवः सैन्धवं प्रति ।
निवर्तमाने तिग्मांशौ हृष्टैः पीतोदकैर्हयैः ॥

meaning.en: Then the Pandava went still faster toward the Saindhava, as the sun turned, with his horses glad and watered.

verses.text:
तं प्रयान्तं महाबाहुं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम् ।
नाशक्नुवन्वारयितुं योधाः क्रुद्धमिवान्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: The warriors could not hold him back as he went, that mighty-armed best of all weapon-bearers, like angry Death.

verses.text:
विद्राव्य तु ततः सैन्यं पाण्डवः शत्रुतापनः ।
यथा मृगगणान्सिंहः सैन्धवार्थे व्यलोडयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the Pandava, scorcher of foes, routing the army, plunged through it for the Saindhava's sake as a lion does a herd of deer.

verses.text:
गाहमानस्त्वनीकानि तूर्णमश्वानचोदयत् ।
बलाकवर्णान्दाशार्हः पाञ्चजन्यं व्यनादयत् ॥

meaning.en: Plunging through the divisions, the Dasharha quickly urged on the crane-white horses and made the Panchajanya sound.

verses.text:
कौन्तेयेनाग्रतः सृष्टा न्यपतन्पृष्ठतः शराः ।
तूर्णात्तूर्णतरं ह्यश्वास्तेऽवहन्वातरंहसः ॥

meaning.en: The arrows loosed forward by Kunti's son fell behind, and the horses went on, swifter and swifter, with the speed of wind.

verses.text:
वातोद्धूतपताकान्तं रथं जलदनिस्वनम् ।
घोरं कपिध्वजं दृष्ट्वा विषण्णा रथिनोऽभवन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the terrible chariot with the ape banner, its flag-ends fluttering in the wind, rumbling like a cloud, the chariot-warriors grew despondent.

verses.text:
दिवाकरेऽथ रजसा सर्वतः संवृते भृशम् ।
शरार्ताश्च रणे योधा न कृष्णौ शेकुरीक्षितुम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, as the sun was thickly covered on all sides by dust, the warriors, tormented by arrows in the battle, could not look at the two Krishnas.

verses.text:
ततो नृपतयः क्रुद्धाः परिवव्रुर्धनंजयम् ।
क्षत्रिया बहवश्चान्ये जयद्रथवधैषिणम् ॥

meaning.en: Then angry kings and many other kshatriyas surrounded Dhananjaya, who was bent on killing Jayadratha.

verses.text:
अपनीयत्सु शल्येषु धिष्ठितं पुरुषर्षभम् ।
दुर्योधनस्त्वगात्पार्थं त्वरमाणो महाहवे ॥

meaning.en: When the arrows had been drawn out, Duryodhana in great haste came against Partha, that bull among men standing there, in the great battle.
